content:
[WORLD STATE — ARC 3: DEMON CONTINENT ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): Rudeus and Eris wake on bare red earth on the Demon Continent, K417, hours after the sky over Fittoa turned to light. A tall green-haired man with a red gem on his forehead and a white spear is watching them.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 10, Eris 12. The Mana Calamity has just erased the Fittoa Region. Its people were teleported at random across the world.
- Rudeus has just met Hitogami (the Man-God) in a white dream for the first time. He advised Rudeus to trust the stranger.
- The stranger is Ruijerd Superdia, a Superd warrior hated and feared everywhere. Rudeus and Eris will form the party "Dead End" with him.
- Fates of the others (unknown to Rudeus): Paul and Norn landed in Fittoa's remains; Paul is organizing the refugee search team. Zenith is missing (trapped far away). Lilia and Aisha were taken in the Shirone Kingdom. Sylphiette was thrown into the sky above the Asura royal palace and saved Princess Ariel. Ghislaine survived somewhere else. Sauros is later executed by Asura as a scapegoat, and Philip and Hilda died in the Calamity.
- Rudeus speaks only Human-Tongue at the start. The Demon Continent speaks Demon-Tongue.
- Goal of the arc: survive and reach the Central Continent, and clear the Superd's name along the way.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 3.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 3.1 — Waking with Ruijerd (K417, Rudeus age 10). Opening: Rudeus and Eris wake on the Demon Continent beside a Superd's campfire. Already true: The Calamity just happened. Hitogami just appeared to Rudeus for the first time.
- Arc 3.2 — Rikarisu: Dead End Begins (K417, Rudeus age 10). Opening: The walled demon city of Rikarisu, its Adventurer's Guild loud with demon voices. Dead End registers for the first time. Already true: Ruijerd has brought them to the city. They have no money and speak little Demon-Tongue.
- Arc 3.3 — The Long Road S

[WORLD STATE — ARC 12: SUMMONING MAGIC & PERUGIUS ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): Old stronghold ruins half a day's walk (an hour on horseback) north of Sharia, K425. Nanahoshi has brought Rudeus's party there; an item imbued with Perugius's teleportation magic will lift them to the floating fortress Chaos Breaker for an audience [LN14].

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 18. Married to Sylphie and Roxy. Lucie is a baby. Rudeus still lacks his left hand.
- Nanahoshi works with Perugius on summoning and teleportation research to return to Earth.
- Perugius Dola is one of the Three Heroes who sealed the Demon God Laplace. He despises Laplace and anyone with Superd or Laplace ties.
- Nanahoshi is about to collapse from Dryne Syndrome, a mana illness of people from another world. The cure lies on the Demon Continent with Kishirika.
- Atoferatofe, the Immortal Demon King, rules her fortress near the coast with her guards. Moore is her loyal retainer.
- Roxy teaches at the Academy. Badigadi has left Sharia.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 12.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 12.1 — Chaos Breaker (K425, Rudeus age 18). Opening: The floating fortress Chaos Breaker. Perugius receives Rudeus. Already true: Rudeus is married to Sylphie and Roxy. Nanahoshi works with Perugius.
- Arc 12.2 — Nanahoshi Falls (K425, Rudeus age 18). Opening: Nanahoshi collapses in her lab. Dryne Syndrome. Already true: The cure must be found on the Demon Continent.
- Arc 12.3 — The Demon King's Fortress (K425, Rudeus age 18). Opening: Coast of the Demon Continent. Atoferatofe's black armored guard bars the way. Already true: Rudeus is searching for Kishirika to save Nanahoshi.

This is the baseline at the arc's start. Active Divergence paths and anything that has happened in play override it.

[WORLD STATE — ARC 18: MILLIS KINGDOM FACTION WAR ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): Millishion, Holy Kingdom of Millis, K429. Rudeus arrives with Zenith, Lilia and Cliff to meet Zenith's mother, Claire Latreia, for the first time.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 22. Cliff returns to Millis to begin his career in the Church.
- Millis is torn between the Pope's faction (Cliff's grandfather, with demon-tolerant views) and the Cardinal's faction (fundamentalists who hate demons, beastfolk and Superd). Claire Latreia stands with the Cardinal.
- The Miko of Millis can read memories and thoughts. She is a political tool of both factions.
- The Temple Knights serve the Church directly. One of Hitogami's apostles is moving pieces in the conflict.
- In canon: the Miko reveals Zenith is aware and loves her family, the Latreia feud is resolved, and Millis becomes an ally.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 18.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 18.1 — Millishion (K429, Rudeus age 22). Opening: Arrival in Millishion with Zenith, Lilia and Cliff. Already true: Cliff is going home to Millis.
- Arc 18.2 — House Latreia (K429, Rudeus age 22). Opening: The Latreia estate. Claire Latreia receives her daughter Zenith. Already true: The Pope and Cardinal factions are on the edge of open conflict.
- Arc 18.3 — The Faction War (K429, Rudeus age 22). Opening: Temple Knights in the streets of Millishion. Already true: The conflict has broken out. Hitogami's apostle is moving.

This is the baseline at the arc's start. Active Divergence paths and anything that has happened in play override it.

[WORLD STATE — ARC 22: CONCLUSION & THE FUTURE ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): Sharia, K430. The war is over. The house is loud with children, and Orsted has new work for Rudeus: the long future.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 23. Geese is dead. Hitogami's offensive was crushed.
- Rudeus keeps working for Orsted, building safeguards so Orsted can defeat Hitogami in the far future.
- Rudeus's children: Lucie, Sieghart (Sylphie); Lara, Lily (Roxy); Ars, Christina (Eris). Some are born in the years after the war.
- The arc covers decades: the children grow up and take their places in the world.
- In canon: Rudeus dies of old age at 74 (K481), surrounded by his family, and meets a defeated Hitogami in the white void one last time.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 22.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 22.1 — Aftermath (K430, Rudeus age 23). Opening: Sharia after the war. Children everywhere, wounds healing. Already true: Geese is dead. The Fighting God Armor is shattered.
- Arc 22.2 — The Grown Children (K440s, Rudeus in his 30s–40s). Opening: Years later. The children are leaving home to find their own paths. Already true: Rudeus is in his thirties and forties, still working for Orsted.
- Arc 22.3 — The Final Days (K481, Rudeus age 74). Opening: Rudeus at 74, surrounded by his family. Already true: The end of a long life.

This is the baseline at the arc's start. Active Divergence paths and anything that has happened in play override it.

[WORLD STATE — ARC 8: RANOA MAGIC ACADEMY ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): Magic City Sharia, K422. Rudeus stands before the Ranoa Magic Academy, recommendation letter in hand, following Hitogami's promise that his condition will be cured here.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 15, still impotent, still believing Eris left him.
- Ranoa Magic Academy: Headmaster Georg; Vice Principal Jenius. Rudeus is admitted as a special student.
- Students: Zanoba Shirone (sent abroad from Shirone, with his assistant Julie later); Cliff Grimoire (arrogant genius, grandson of the Pope of Millis); Linia Dedoldia and Pursena Adoldia (beastfolk princess delinquents who rule the school by force); Princess Ariel Anemoi Asura with Luke Notos Greyrat and "Silent Fitz", a masked white-haired bodyguard who is secretly Sylphiette.
- Badigadi, the Immortal Demon Lord, enrolls on a whim and wants to test Rudeus.
- Nanahoshi, now called "Silent Sevenstars", researches summoning magic to go home.
- Elinalise Dragonroad, Sylphie's grandmother and Paul's old party member, arrives soon after.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 8.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 8.1 — Enrollment (K422, Rudeus age 15). Opening: Ranoa Magic Academy, the headmaster's office. Rudeus arrives as a special student. Already true: Hitogami promised a cure here.
- Arc 8.2 — Delinquents and a Demon Lord (K422, Rudeus age 15). Opening: The Academy's beastfolk princesses rule the halls, and a laughing six-armed Demon Lord has heard about Rudeus. Already true: Rudeus has met Zanoba again and Cliff for the first time. Silent Fitz watches him.
- Arc 8.3 — Silent Fitz (K422, Rudeus age 15). Opening: Fitz, the masked white-haired bodyguard, asks Rudeus to help with something private. Already true: Rudeus and Fitz are friends. He has no idea Fitz is Sylphie. Elinalise has arrived in Sharia.

This is the baseline at the arc's start. Active Divergence paths and anything that ha

[WORLD STATE — ARC 21: THE FINAL BATTLE & GEESE'S TRAP ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): The Biheiril Kingdom, K430. Battle lines are drawn in the forests and hills. Every ally Rudeus has gathered stands with him; across the field wait gods.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 23. This is the final battle against Hitogami's forces.
- Enemies: Sword God Gal Farion, North God Kalman III (Alexander Rybak), the Ogre God and Badigadi wearing the Fighting God Armor, all led by Geese. Atoferatofe and Kalman II (Sandor) fight on Rudeus's side [LN22–25].
- Allies: Eris, Ruijerd, Zanoba, Orsted (who must ration his mana), the Superd warriors, and others Rudeus recruited.
- Rudeus fights in the Magic Armor.
- In canon: Geese dies, the Fighting God Armor shatters around Badigadi, Alexander yields, and Hitogami's final offensive is broken. The cost is high.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 21.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 21.1 — Eve of Battle (K430, Rudeus age 23). Opening: The camp before the battle. Allies and enemies are in position. Already true: Everything is ready for the final war.
- Arc 21.2 — Geese's Trap (K430, Rudeus age 23). Opening: Mid-battle. The plan breaks apart and Geese's trap closes. Already true: The battle is underway. The Fighting God Armor is on the field.

This is the baseline at the arc's start. Active Divergence paths and anything that has happened in play override it.

[WORLD STATE — ARC 14: ASURA KINGDOM SUCCESSION ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): Sharia, K425. Rudeus and Princess Ariel prepare to cross to the Asura Kingdom by teleportation circle; Orsted's orders are to put Ariel on the throne.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- After the duel Orsted restores Rudeus's lost left arm; Zanoba and Cliff then finish the Zaliff Gauntlet [LN16].
- Rudeus is 18, now Orsted's subordinate. Wives: Sylphie (with Lucie), Roxy (with Lara), Eris (Sword King).
- Ariel returns to Asura to claim the throne from First Prince Grabel's faction, backed by High Minister Darius Silva Ganius. Her father the king is deathly ill.
- Darius employs Water God Reida Lia and North Emperor Auber Corbett. The Man-God has three disciples here: Luke, Darius and Reida [LN17].
- Ariel's party: Luke Notos Greyrat, Sylphie, Eris, Ghislaine, Rudeus and the attendants Ellemoi and Cleane. Elinalise (pregnant) and Cliff remain in Sharia.
- Orsted joins only when necessary; using his mana costs him greatly.
- In canon: Orsted kills Reida; Ghislaine kills Auber and beheads Darius; Pilemon is deposed and Luke heads the Notos; Ariel's victory is certain but the coronation comes later. Details: see the Arc 14 Canon Details entry.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 14.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 14.1 — Departure for Asura (K425, Rudeus age 18). Opening: Ariel's party prepares at the teleport circle outside Sharia. Already true: Orsted's orders: put Ariel on the throne.
- Arc 14.2 — The Capital Ars (K425, Rudeus age 18). Opening: Ars, the Asura capital: balls, plots, assassins and Darius's court. Already true: The party has reached the capital.
- Arc 14.3 — The Palace Ball (K425, Rudeus age 18). Opening: The palace ball in Ars: Darius unmasked by Tristina, Perugius in the hall, the Water God about to drop through the ceiling. Already true: The political game is lost for Darius. Only violence is left.

This is the baseline at

[WORLD STATE — ARC 15: SUBORDINATES & MERCENARY ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): Sharia, K427. Rudeus hears that Linia Dedoldia, the beastfolk princess from his Academy days, has drowned in debt and is about to be sold at a slave auction.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 20. Ariel is Queen of Asura and Orsted's most powerful ally.
- Eris is pregnant (Ars).
- Rudeus is building Orsted's network: a mercenary company for intelligence, supplies and influence.
- Linia ran up huge debts in a failed business. Pursena Adoldia is in Sharia too.
- In canon: Rudeus buys Linia and makes her the head of the Ruquag's Mercenary Band, with Pursena as her partner. The Magic Armor Mk II (lighter) becomes his everyday gear.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 15.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 15.1 — Linia's Auction (K427, Rudeus age 20). Opening: A slave auction in Sharia. Linia is on the block. Already true: Ariel is Queen. Eris is pregnant.
- Arc 15.2 — The Mercenary Band (K427, Rudeus age 20). Opening: The new office of the Ruquag's Mercenary Band, buzzing with recruits. Already true: Linia and Pursena run the band. The Magic Armor Mk II is ready.

This is the baseline at the arc's start. Active Divergence paths and anything that has happened in play override it.

[WORLD STATE — ARC 11: EVERYDAY LIFE & ROXY ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): The road back to Sharia, K424. Zenith rides silent and unseeing; Rudeus's left sleeve hangs empty. Roxy sits beside him, and something has changed between them.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 17. Paul is dead. Rudeus lost his left hand in Begaritt. Roxy and Rudeus became lovers after Paul's death.
- Zenith is alive but her memory and personality are gone; she barely reacts. Lilia cares for her.
- Sylphie is about to give birth (Lucie, their first child).
- Roxy will become Rudeus's second wife. Sylphie accepts her.
- Norn and Aisha learn their father died. Norn enrolls at the Academy and lives in the dormitory. Aisha runs the house.
- Talhand and Geese go their own ways after Begaritt.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 11.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 11.1 — The Road Home (K424, Rudeus age 17). Opening: The road back to Sharia with Zenith, Lilia and Roxy. Already true: Paul is dead. Rudeus lost his left hand. Zenith has no memories.
- Arc 11.2 — Lucie (K424, Rudeus age 17). Opening: Sylphie goes into labor in the Greyrat house in Sharia. Already true: Roxy has come home with Rudeus. The family must accept a new arrangement.

This is the baseline at the arc's start. Active Divergence paths and anything that has happened in play override it.

[WORLD STATE — ARC 2: FITTOA REGION TUTOR ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): Evening; a carriage with Ghislaine aboard rolls through the gates of the city of Roa, K414. Paul knocked seven-year-old Rudeus out in a sword bout and tricked him into leaving Buena Village to become the tutor of a noble girl who has already driven several teachers away.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 7. Voiceless Casting, an enormous mana pool, Water and Earth magic far beyond his age. Roxy's teaching is finished; she left Buena years ago.
- Sylphiette stayed behind in Buena Village, heartbroken. Rudeus had grown too close to her, so Paul separated them.
- Norn (Zenith's daughter) and Aisha (Lilia's daughter) are toddlers in Buena. Lilia became Paul's second wife.
- Boreas Greyrat house in Roa: Lord Sauros (loud, fierce, secretly fond of beastfolk), Philip (Eris's father, Paul's cousin, a scheming politician), Hilda (Eris's mother).
- Eris Boreas Greyrat, nine [LN2]: violent, expelled from school, can only write her name and add, red hair, hits first. She refuses all tutors.
- Ghislaine Dedoldia: beastfolk Sword King, Eris's bodyguard and swordmaster. Illiterate.
- Roxy is traveling; she serves for a time as a court mage tutor in the Shirone Kingdom.
- The Mana Calamity strikes Fittoa in K417, around Rudeus's tenth birthday. It cannot be stopped.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 2.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 2.1 — Arrival in Roa (K414, Rudeus age 7). Opening: The carriage stops at the Boreas Greyrat estate. The young lady of the house has already beaten several tutors. Already true: Rudeus is 7, separated from Sylphie by Paul's trick.
- Arc 2.2 — The Kidnapping (K414, Rudeus age 7). Opening: Rudeus's staged kidnapping of Eris, meant to win her trust, turns real when actual kidnappers take them both. Already true: Rudeus is 7. Eris refuses to study. Philip and Ghislaine are in on the staged plan.
- Arc 2.3 — The Years in Ro

[WORLD STATE — ARC 5: SHIRONE KINGDOM REUNION ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): Dead End reaches Latakia, capital of the Shirone Kingdom, K419, two years after the Displacement [LN6]. Rumors say a maid and a little girl from Fittoa are being held in the palace.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 12. In Millishion he met Paul, they fought bitterly, then reconciled. Paul keeps searching for Zenith. Norn stays with Paul.
- Hitogami told Rudeus to go to Shirone.
- Lilia and Aisha are prisoners of Prince Pax Shirone (Seventh Prince, cruel, obsessed with Roxy, his former tutor). He uses them as bait to lure Roxy back.
- Zanoba Shirone, Third Prince: a Blessed Child with monstrous strength who once accidentally killed people, now obsessed with figurines. He owns a Roxy figure that Rudeus carved.
- Roxy is not in Shirone. She is traveling the world looking for the Greyrats.
- After Shirone, the road leads north toward the ruins of Fittoa.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 5.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 5.1 — Arrival in Shirone (K419, Rudeus age 12). Opening: Latakia, capital of Shirone. Rumors of Fittoa prisoners in the palace. Already true: Rudeus reconciled with Paul. Hitogami sent him here.
- Arc 5.2 — Pax's Trap (K419, Rudeus age 12). Opening: Inside the Shirone palace, Rudeus is caught in Pax's magic barrier. A huge, gentle prince with a figurine comes to the cell. Already true: Rudeus is captive. Lilia and Aisha are hostages. Zanoba is about to intervene.

This is the baseline at the arc's start. Active Divergence paths and anything that has happened in play override it.

[WORLD STATE — ARC 4: VOYAGE TO MILLIS ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): Wind Port, on the Demon Continent's coast, K418. Dead End has crossed the continent and now needs passage over the Ringus Sea, but no ship will carry a Superd.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 11, Eris 13. Dead End (Rudeus, Eris, Ruijerd) is a known Adventurer's Guild party, A rank by now.
- Rudeus speaks Demon-Tongue. He is learning Beast-Tongue for the road ahead.
- The Demon Emperor Kishirika Kishirisu, small and childish, is about to cross their path. She gives Rudeus the Demon Eye of Foresight.
- Across the sea: Zant Port (Millis Continent, smugglers and beastfolk trafficking) and the Great Forest of the beastfolk, where the rainy season can trap travelers for months.
- Paul is in Millishion leading the Fittoa Territory Search and Rescue. Norn is with him. Paul has spent the past year drinking, grieving and searching. He does not know Rudeus survived.
- Lilia and Aisha are still captive in Shirone. Zenith is still missing. Sylphiette serves Princess Ariel in Asura in secret.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 4.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 4.1 — Wind Port (K418, Rudeus age 11). Opening: Wind Port on the coast. No ship will take a Superd across the sea. Already true: Dead End is A rank. Kishirika's encounter is close.
- Arc 4.2 — Zant Port (K418, Rudeus age 11). Opening: Zant Port, Millis Continent. A smuggler named Gallus is moving beastfolk children through the docks. Already true: They crossed the sea. Rudeus has the Demon Eye of Foresight.
- Arc 4.3 — The Great Forest (K418, Rudeus age 11). Opening: The Doldia village in the Great Forest, where the rainy season has begun and travel stops for months. Already true: After Zant Port, Dead End is in the beastfolk lands. Misunderstandings with the Doldia tribe are close.
- Arc 4.4 — Millishion: Paul (K418, Rudeus age 11). Opening: Millishion, capital of Millis. In a tavern, a dru

[WORLD STATE — ARC 10: TELEPORTATION LABYRINTH ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): The Begaritt desert, K423. Rudeus and Elinalise step out of an ancient teleportation circle into blinding heat, days from the Labyrinth City of Rapan and its Teleportation Labyrinth.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 16. He left a pregnant Sylphie in Sharia to answer Paul's letter asking for help.
- Zenith is trapped in the depths of the Teleportation Labyrinth, sealed inside a giant magic crystal.
- Paul, Lilia, Talhand, Geese, Roxy, Vierra and Shierra have been working toward the labyrinth. Roxy has been lost inside it.
- The labyrinth is full of teleport traps. Its guardian is the Manatite Hydra, whose magic-stone scales absorb mana.
- In canon: Roxy is rescued, Paul dies saving Rudeus from the Hydra, Rudeus loses his left hand, and Zenith is freed but left without her memories.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 10.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 10.1 — The Desert (K423, Rudeus age 16). Opening: Rudeus and Elinalise in the Begaritt desert after the teleport. Already true: Sylphie stays pregnant in Sharia.
- Arc 10.2 — Rapan (K423, Rudeus age 16). Opening: The Labyrinth City of Rapan. Paul's party is gathered in a cheap inn. Already true: Paul has news: Zenith is in the Teleportation Labyrinth. Roxy is lost inside it.
- Arc 10.3 — The Labyrinth (K423, Rudeus age 16). Opening: The Teleportation Labyrinth: shifting teleport traps, crystal monsters, no way back but forward. Already true: Roxy is rescued. The party pushes for the lowest floor.
- Arc 10.4 — The Hydra (K423, Rudeus age 16). Opening: The guardian chamber. A Manatite Hydra with reflective scales coils around a giant crystal holding Zenith. Already true: Everyone is exhausted. This fight decides who lives.

This is the baseline at the arc's start. Active Divergence paths and anything that has happened in play override it.

[WORLD STATE — ARC 19: KING DRAGON REALM ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): Sharia, K429. A letter in Geese Nukadia's clumsy hand reaches Rudeus. It is friendly, almost cheerful, and it declares war.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 22. Geese, Paul's old party member, is Hitogami's last and most loyal apostle.
- Geese is gathering powerful warriors for a final war against Orsted and Rudeus.
- Rudeus and Orsted race to find allies, artifacts and Geese's location.
- Orsted's goal is to reach Hitogami in the far future; Rudeus is building safeguards to help.
- Rudeus's family: three wives and growing children. All are now targets.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 19.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 19.1 — Geese's Letter (K429, Rudeus age 22). Opening: A friendly letter from Geese declares war. Already true: Geese is Hitogami's last apostle.
- Arc 19.2 — Gathering Allies (K429, Rudeus age 22). Opening: Rudeus crosses continents with teleport circles, knocking on the doors of old friends and dangerous powers. Already true: War is coming. Every ally counts.

This is the baseline at the arc's start. Active Divergence paths and anything that has happened in play override it.

[WORLD STATE — ARC 16: SHIRONE DEFENSE & PAX ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): Sharia, K427. A letter arrives for Zanoba from Shirone: the kingdom is under attack, and the King recalls his brother home to defend it.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 20. Pax Shirone, once the hated Seventh Prince, became King of Shirone in a coup, backed by Randolph Marianne, the Death God: a King Dragon Realm knight with a skeletal face, fifth of the Seven Great Powers [LN19].
- Pax is despised by his people and his court. He secretly wants to reform Shirone into a better country.
- An invading army threatens the capital. Rudeus suspects one of Hitogami's apostles is behind it.
- Zanoba returns to defend Shirone. Roxy and Rudeus go with him. Julie and Ginger accompany Zanoba.
- In canon: the invasion is beaten, but Pax, betrayed and alone, takes his own life. Hitogami gains a strategic victory.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 16.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 16.1 — Zanoba's Recall (K427, Rudeus age 20). Opening: A letter recalls Zanoba to Shirone. Already true: Pax is King of Shirone.
- Arc 16.2 — The Siege (K427, Rudeus age 20). Opening: Shirone's capital under attack. Pax in a nearly empty throne room. Already true: Rudeus, Roxy and Zanoba have arrived to defend Shirone.

This is the baseline at the arc's start. Active Divergence paths and anything that has happened in play override it.

[WORLD STATE — ARC 7: THE QUAGMIRE ADVENTURER ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): Rosenburg, Northern Territories, K421. A cold Adventurer's Guild hall; a fifteen-year-old boy everyone calls "Rudeus of the Quagmire" takes the most dangerous job on the board, alone.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 14–15. He believes Eris abandoned him. He suffers erectile dysfunction from the trauma and is deeply depressed. He solos missions recklessly so his name will reach his missing mother.
- Eris trains at the Holy Land of Swords under Sword God Gal Farion, with Ghislaine. She means to return once she is strong enough.
- Paul has a lead and is heading for the Begaritt Continent with Lilia, his old party members, and Roxy, looking for Zenith.
- Norn and Aisha will later be escorted north by Ruijerd.
- Soldat Heckler, a veteran adventurer, takes a dim view of the Quagmire.
- Sylphiette, now white-haired from the Calamity, is Princess Ariel's bodyguard. Ariel lost the first succession contest and has fled to Ranoa with Luke and Sylphie.

START POINTS (command "Start at Arc 7.P"; point 1 is the arc's opening):
- Arc 7.1 — The Quagmire (K421, Rudeus age 14). Opening: Rosenburg Adventurer's Guild. Rudeus takes the most dangerous job on the board, alone. Already true: Eris is gone; Rudeus believes she rejected him. He is impotent and depressed.
- Arc 7.2 — Soldat's Challenge (K422, Rudeus age 15). Opening: Soldat Heckler blocks the Quagmire's path and says out loud what everyone thinks of him. Already true: Rudeus has been soloing for months. His fame is growing for the wrong reasons.

This is the baseline at the arc's start. Active Divergence paths and anything that has happened in play override it.

[WORLD STATE — ARC 6: HOMECOMING & SEPARATION ARC — canon at the START of the arc]
OPENING SCENE (use when starting at this arc): North of Shirone, about four months after leaving it, K419–K420 [LN6]. Dead End's wagon climbs toward the Red Dragon's Upper Jaw, the pass into the Asura Kingdom, with Lilia and Aisha now safe and the end of the long journey in sight.

WHERE THINGS STAND:
- Rudeus is 12, about to turn 13; Eris 14, about to turn 15 [LN6]. Lilia and Aisha were rescued from Pax and are on their way to Paul.
- In the pass waits Orsted, the Dragon God, cursed so every living thing hates and fears him. Nanahoshi Shizuka travels with him: a Japanese girl transferred into the world in her own body.
- Fittoa is a wasteland of grass. A refugee camp and Alphonse (former Boreas steward) remain. Sauros has been executed. Eris's parents are dead.
